content: DXF web viewers universally offer: mouse-wheel zoom + drag-pan (with Fit/Zoom-in/Zoom-out/Reset buttons), a layer panel with per-layer show/hide plus Show-All/Hide-All/Invert, hover-highlight + click-to-select entities with a Properties panel showing geometry/attributes, ctrl-click for multi-select, and click-two-points distance measurement with endpoint/vertex snapping. Cross-confirmed across mustafakbaser/DXF-Viewer, mlightcad/cad-viewer, and multiple online viewers.
